issues.description: Function parameter order mismatch for teleport_s. The problem statement declares the function signature as teleport_s(circ: stim.Circuit, data_qubit: int, injection_qubit: int, p = 0.0) -> int. The solution implementation uses the same ordering (data_qubit then injection_qubit). The template implementation, however, declares teleport_s(circ: stim.Circuit, injection_qubit: int, data_qubit: int, p = 0.0) -> int (injection_qubit then data_qubit). This inconsistency between the template and the problem statement/solution can confuse students about which argument corresponds to the data qubit vs. the injection qubit and can lead to incorrect calls or failing tests expecting the data_qubit-first ordering.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template function signature match the problem statement and solution. Change the template's teleport_s signature to: def teleport_s(circ: stim.Circuit, data_qubit: int, injection_qubit: int, p: float = 0.0) -> int. Update the template docstring and any internal parameter references/comments to use the same ordering (data_qubit then injection_qubit) so students implement/code against a single consistent API.

issues.description: The function teleport_s (teleportation of the S gate) is referred to with the parameter order (circ, data_qubit, injection_qubit, p=0.0) in the problem statement and implemented with that same ordering in the reference solution, but the template stub declares the parameters in the swapped order (circ, injection_qubit, data_qubit, p=0.0). Concept: teleporting an S gate from an ancilla (injection_qubit) onto a data qubit (data_qubit). Problem statement name/order: teleport_s(circ, data_qubit, injection_qubit, p=0.0). Template stub name/order: teleport_s(circ, injection_qubit, data_qubit, p=0.0). Solution implementation name/order: teleport_s(circ, data_qubit, injection_qubit, p=0.0). This mismatch can mislead students about which argument is the data qubit vs the injection ancilla, causing incorrect calls or implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the API across artifacts. Change the template stub signature to match the problem statement and solution: def teleport_s(circ: stim.Circuit, data_qubit: int, injection_qubit: int, p: float = 0.0) -> int. Also update the template docstring/argument descriptions so the order and roles (data_qubit: target of the teleported S; injection_qubit: ancilla prepared in |Y>) match the problem text.
